FN-4AQL3I-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 399
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/28/2023
House Bill 399 as introduced would not directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-4AQL3I-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 399
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/17/2023
House Bill 399 as reported by the Committee on State Government would create the
eleven-member Alabama Ad Valorem Advisory Committee, which could increase the
administrative duties of the Department of Revenue to review recommendations regarding
assessment and collection of ad valorem taxes, pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-4AQL3I-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 399
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/30/2023
House Bill 399 as passed the House of Representatives would create the eleven-member
Alabama Ad Valorem Advisory Committee, which could increase the administrative duties of
the Department of Revenue to review recommendations regarding assessment and collection of
ad valorem taxes, pursuant to this bill.
Page 1
